project: CivicAid — Village Legal & Government Assistance Platform

knowledge_base.verification_status: All 59 chunks default to verified=false as of 2026-09-30. None have yet been checked against primary sources (Acts, TN Revenue Standing Orders, Government Orders). See scripts/add_verification_fields.py.
knowledge_base.note: Run GET /api/eval/coverage for live accurate counts

evaluation.caveat: These 150 questions were authored alongside the knowledge base itself, not independently by a legal professional. They measure retrieval consistency, not legal accuracy.

model.llm_primary: Groq (model set via GROQ_MODEL in .env; see app/services/ai_service.py MODEL_CANDIDATES)
model.retrieval: Hybrid BM25 + Dense (FAISS IndexFlatIP) via Reciprocal Rank Fusion

pages.home: Landing page with bilingual hero, feature grid, how-it-works
pages.chat: RAG-augmented AI chat with voice input, offline queue, verified/unverified source labels, confidence score
pages.upload: Document OCR analysis with real extracted text, document vault, deadline reminders
pages.procedures: Step-by-step offline government service guides with progress tracking

voice_input: Web Speech API — ta-IN locale, best on Android Chrome
offline_capability: Procedures page and local chat fallbacks work without internet
helpline: 1516 (Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority, toll-free, 24/7)
